channel.description: Latest articles from The Lawrence Times (lawrencekstimes.com)

item.title: KU to hold festival to celebrate Latin American classical music
item.description: KU is set to host its second annual Latin American Art Music Festival, which will highlight musical traditions from Mexico, Central America, South America and the Caribbean. Continue reading ...

item.title: Douglas County property owners to see value increases of 1-8%
item.description: The Douglas County appraiser's office will soon mail out change of value notices, and owners of most residential and commercial properties will see valuation increases of 1% to 8%. Continue reading ...

item.title: Kansas Senate approves cap on property valuations, despite questions on real tax savings
item.description: The Kansas Senate passed a resolution Wednesday to cap property valuation increases at 3%, the first step toward achieving a constitutional change that would need to be approved by voters. Continue reading ...

item.title: Transgender Kansans had their IDs invalidated overnight, causing confusion and panic
item.description: Some transgender Kansans received letters urging them to request new IDs that conflict with their gender identity and presentation, because their current ones are "invalid immediately." It’s the result of a new law that also regulates which bathrooms transgender people are allowed to use. Continue reading ...

item.title: Lawrence advisory board wants to commit city to a climate plan with ‘more teeth’
item.description: The Environmental Sustainability Advisory Board will ask the Lawrence City Commission to revise a renewable energy ordinance that city staff members want to instead repeal and replace with a climate neutrality resolution. Continue reading ...

item.title: Trans men file lawsuit over Kansas law that restricts bathroom use and invalidates driver’s licenses
item.description: Two transgender men from Lawrence are suing the state over a new law that invalidates driver’s licenses and restricts bathroom use based on sex assigned at birth, citing numerous constitutional rights and fear of violence. Continue reading ...

item.title: Reminder: Lawrence Transit On Demand to start charging per ride
item.description: Reminder: Lawrence Transit will start charging $3 for each one-way on demand ride starting Sunday, and the city will only accept credit card payments. Continue reading ...

item.title: Kansas Court of Appeals rules CoreCivic can’t house ICE detainees without Leavenworth permit
item.description: CoreCivic can’t house immigration detainees before reaching an agreement with the city of Leavenworth on reopening its private prison, the Kansas Court of Appeals ruled Friday when it upheld a lower court’s decision. Continue reading ...

item.title: Arraignment delayed for former Lawrence school speech pathologist charged with child sex crimes
item.description: Attorneys agreed to delay arraignment and selection of a jury trial date for a former Prairie Park Elementary School speech pathologist facing charges of sex crimes against students. Continue reading ...

item.title: ICE agents arrest people in Lawrence and on KU campus, advocates say
item.description: ICE agents returned to Lawrence Friday morning and detained people on KU’s campus and elsewhere, according to local immigration advocates. Continue reading ...
